parts.title: PART 1: READING INPUT  BUILDING THE CASE FOR SMARTPHONES
content: To write a strong argumentative essay, you must understand BOTH sides of the debate. Today, we research the strongest arguments IN FAVOR of children having smartphones.
The three most common pro-smartphone arguments are:
ARGUMENT 1 — SAFETY & COMMUNICATION: Smartphones allow children to contact parents in emergencies. Location-sharing features help parents monitor their child's safety.

ARGUMENT 2 — EDUCATION & LEARNING: Educational apps, online libraries, and learning platforms expand learning beyond school. Research shows children with supervised internet access score higher in reading.
ARGUMENT 3 — DIGITAL LITERACY: In a digital world, early exposure to technology prepares children for modern society. Students who learn responsible tech use early develop better self-regulation.
(↑ Re-read the story above to answer:)
T / F: The text is about building the case for smartphones.
